app.name: Probo
app.tagline: Evidence, one document at a time.

atypicalReason.UNEXPECTED_TYPE: Type not expected for this campaign

foundation.description: The front end consumes @probo/shared, which carries the Zod schemas and the business rules. The code is in English, the interface is translated: no raw value ever reaches a screen.

verdict.notOverridable: This verdict cannot be overridden: there is no text to analyse.

rejectionReason.NOT_REGULAR_FILE: Symbolic link or special entry, not a regular file
rejectionReason.FILE_TOO_LARGE: Exceeds the maximum size per file ({{maxMb}} MB)

auth.pitch: Probo first checks what each file is, then only scores the ones it is sure about. Doubtful documents are flagged, never graded at random.
auth.hosting: Data hosted in the European Union · 90-day retention
auth.title: Sign in
auth.subtitle: Reach your institution's applications.
auth.throttleNotice: After six attempts, further tries are delayed.
auth.unavailable: The service is briefly unavailable. Try again in a moment.
auth.noSelfSignup: Accounts are created by your institution's administrator. There is no self sign-up.

account.title: Accounts
account.subtitle: Your team, and what each of them may do.
account.name: Name
account.EMAIL_ALREADY_USED: That address already carries an account.
account.UNAVAILABLE: That did not go through. Try again.
account.noDeletion: An account is deactivated, never deleted: the batches it imported stay visible and stay attributed to it, and the audit trail stays readable.

invitation.title: Choose your password
invitation.subtitle: Your administrator gave you this link. It works once.
invitation.minLength: At least {{min}} characters. Length matters more than symbols.
invitation.refusedDetail: It may already have been used, or expired. Ask your administrator for a new one.
invitation.issued: Invitation link — pass it on yourself
invitation.noEmail: Probo sends no email. Creating an account produces a link you pass on however you like. Its owner chooses their own password: you must never know it, or the audit trail stops proving who acted.

campaign.title: Campaigns
campaign.subtitle: A campaign frames the analysis of one recruitment session.
campaign.empty: No campaign yet. Create one to get started.
campaign.name: Campaign name
campaign.readOnly: Only an administrator configures a campaign.

expectedTypes.title: Expected documents
expectedTypes.help: What you ask of every candidate. A document whose detected type is not on this list is marked atypical and leaves the score computation. At least one type is required.
expectedTypes.atLeastOne: At least one type is required.

weighting.title: Weighting of the three axes
weighting.help: A document's score is the weighted mean of its three sub-scores. Weights are normalised by their sum, so they need not add up to 100. A weighting that is zero throughout is refused.
weighting.allZero: A weighting that is zero throughout is refused.

threshold.title: Confidence threshold
threshold.help: Below this threshold the system considers it does not know which document it is looking at: the document is marked atypical and is not scored.

reference.title: Comparison reference
reference.help: What level 2 compares each document against to produce the relevance sub-score. One reference per expected type: a cover letter is not judged on what a CV is expected to show.
reference.warning: Describe the profile you are looking for; do not copy an admitted file.
reference.warningDetail: A reference built from a real candidate's CV reproduces their school, their path and their implicit age across the whole next intake. In admissions, that is a selection bias you would have to justify.
reference.placeholder: Describe the profile sought for this document type.
reference.tooShort: Describe the profile in a few sentences — at least {{min}} characters.
reference.unchanged: Changing a reference leaves analyses already produced alone.
reference.uploadLater: Uploading a reference document arrives with the extraction chain.

activation.NO_EXPECTED_TYPE: No expected document type is ticked.
activation.MISSING_REFERENCE_PROFILE: An expected type has no reference.
activation.ZERO_WEIGHTING: The weighting of the three axes is zero throughout.
activation.CLOSED_WINDOW: The closing date precedes the opening date.
